parties: Adarsh Advisory Services Private Limited; JSW Cement Limited
headline: Adarsh Advisory Services files SEBI Regulation 31(4) takeover disclosure for JSW Cement
sum: Adarsh Advisory Services Private Limited has filed a mandatory Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE, signalling a substantial acquisition in JSW Cement Limited that has triggered takeover code compliance obligations. The filing indicates the acquirer's shareholding or voting rights have reached or exceeded 25%, mandating a public open offer to minority shareholders under the SEBI Takeover Code.
implication: A Regulation 31(4) disclosure is a gate-keeper filing that locks the acquirer into open-offer mechanics; counsel must immediately review the acquirer's ability to carry the price-band valuation and ensure the open offer timeline and documentation comply with current SEBI takeover code rules and any recent amendments to Regulation 37 (pricing floors).
detail: Adarsh Advisory Services Private Limited has submitted a mandatory disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4), to the National Stock Exchange, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares in JSW Cement Limited. This filing is triggered once an acquirer's shareholding or voting rights reach or exceed 25% or such other threshold as prescribed in the regulations. The disclosure initiates formal takeover regulation compliance and requires the acquirer to launch a public open offer to minority shareholders at a price determined by valuation norms under the takeover code. The acquisition structure, consideration amount, and timing of the open offer remain to be disclosed in the formal Regulation 31(4) public announcement.
